<h2>Research themes</h2>
<div class="areas">
<section class="area">
<h3>Stochastic models &amp; memory</h3>
<p>Point processes, diffusions, and models of stochastic intensity and volatility. Particular interests include flexible distributions, long memory, and Markov structure.</p>
</section>
<section class="area">
<h3>Financial market dynamics</h3>
<p>Models of price changes, order arrivals, and durations, connecting stochastic structures with financial market data.</p>
</section>
<section class="area">
<h3>Inference, computation &amp; derivatives</h3>
<p>Statistical inference and simulation for stochastic models, with earlier work on option pricing and hedging.</p>
</section>
</div>
